body_html:
You can follow along how I quit and unquit facebook here: https://indieweb.org/silo-quits @actualham is correct the #IndieWeb hasn't figured out the hyper local. The day I was suggesting #LRA19 had a moral obligation not to use facebook I rejoined to find my son's dog (turns out phone number on collar would have been fine) but I miss the local swap and sell groups, the local news.

I need to sell my car. facebook is so fast

I do think we can fix this. In fact I believe more in a local web than a decentralized one. i want to empower local paers and local libraries through open pedagogy to return these key networks back to the people.
